name: astex_crossdock_samefamily
description: Valid cross-docking benchmark built from same-target / same-family pairs of the Astex Diverse Set. Each pair docks ligand B's crystal ligand into receptor A, where A and B belong to the same protein family (shared binding pocket). The oracle binding site is taken from the ACCEPTOR receptor A; the reference ligand for RMSD is B's crystal ligand in B's frame (cross-crystal RMSD superimposes into A's frame). Replaces the prior invalid cyclic-shift alphabetical bijection which paired structurally unrelated proteins. The Astex Diverse Set is deliberately non-redundant: only ONE pair of structures shares the identical protein (Factor Xa: 1LPZ/1MQ6, flagged same_protein=true); all other pairs are same-family fallbacks.
